description: Historical real Cashify final quotes recovered from repository history (commit 102af18, 2026-08-09: verify_nothing.ts / brute_force_nothing.ts / optimize_nothing.ts). Each entry records Cashify's quote, the Cashify Get Upto used at the time, and the answers the calibration script applied. Lower confidence than the 2026-09-20/24 fixtures: variant, questionnaire modes and exact observation date were not recorded, and Cashify may have changed its rules since. Evidence only - never used to tune production rules without fresh Cashify controls.
provenanceNotes: All 30 quotes end in 0 (Cashify rounds to Rs 10); Fhoneify outputs do not, so these are Cashify figures, not Fhoneify targets.
The August scripts fitted Fhoneify's uplifted price to these numbers; compare them with the Cashify condition equivalent instead.

Nothing camera/battery/bill constants in lib/pricingCalculator.ts were fitted from this table in August, so the functional and bill parts are partly in-sample. Touch, local-display and screen-scratch rules were replaced later and are out-of-sample.
Use catalog model names (not the August script names such as 'Nothing 1') so production family routing applies.

C1_TOUCH_SCREEN_BACKCAM.profile: touch not working, 1-2 screen scratches, back camera faulty, warranty yes, GST bill yes, box + charger

C2_LOCAL_DISPLAY_FRONTCAM.profile: local/non-original display, front camera faulty, warranty yes, GST bill yes, box

C3_NOBILL_HEAVY_SCREEN_BATTERY.profile: no GST bill, warranty yes, >2 screen scratches, battery health issue, box + charger
